# Darkroom titles, lower-thirds and text

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/titles`

## Summary

Title clips are assetless clips rendered from up to eight text, rectangle and line layers; they make lower-thirds, title cards and end cards.

## Details

A title clip has up to 8 layers of type text, rect or line. Coordinates are fractions of the frame (0 to 1, x/y of a text block are its centre).
### Text layer
- text up to 500 characters; fontFamily (below); fontWeight 400 or 700; fillColor; align left, center or right
- `fontSizePx` (font size (project pixels)): 8 to 500, default 64, step 1
- `strokeWidthPx` (outline width): 0 to 50, default 0, step 1
- `letterSpacingPx` (letter spacing): -20 to 100, default 0, step 0.5
- `lineHeight` (line height): 0.5 to 3, default 1.2, step 0.05
- shadow {xPx, yPx, blurPx, color}: offsets -100 to 100, blur 0 to 100
- background {color, opacity 0–1, paddingXPx, paddingYPx, radiusPx}: padding 0 to 200, radius 0 to 200
### Rectangle layer: x, y, w, h (0–1), color, opacity 0–1, radiusPx
### Line layer: x1, y1, x2, y2 (0–1), color, thicknessPx 1 to 100
### Fonts
- sans: Inter, Noto Sans, Open Sans, Montserrat, Poppins, Raleway, DejaVu Sans
- serif: Playfair Display, Merriweather, Lora
- display: Oswald, Bebas Neue (regular only), Anton (regular only)
- mono: JetBrains Mono, Space Mono
- script: Dancing Script, Pacifico (regular only)
Default font: Inter.
A lower-third sits in the bottom 30 % of the frame, left-aligned with a safe margin (x about 0.06–0.1), a name line in bold and a role line smaller; animate it in with an opacity or position keyframe over the first 0.3–0.6 s. Press T to add a title clip at the playhead.
